h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagaon

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nagaon

c: Nagaon lies in central Assam on the Brahmaputra plain, a district of tea gardens, paddy fields and busy market towns. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nagaon for schools, colleges, residential colonies, tea estate communities and the municipal board. Every Fun Fitness machine is built at our Vasai factory, about 2170 km away, and travels to the north-east by road.

Installation is done by our own team or a dealer from our eastern India network. Assam's rain is long and heavy, often starting before the monsoon proper, and humidity stays high for months. Galvanised frames resist rust in these conditions. Because the distance is long, we plan everything on the layout drawing before dispatch, so the full set arrives together and is installed in one visit.

items.q: Can you deliver outdoor gym equipment to Assam?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road to the north-east. A regional dealer or our own team installs the machines once they reach Nagaon.

items.q: How should we look after the machines in Assam's rain?
items.a: Clear moss and weeds from the footings, wipe the handles and joints after long wet spells and check the bolts before and after the monsoon.

items.q: Can a tea estate order a gym for its workers' community?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the area and the number of families, and we will suggest a set of machines and send a layout drawing with a quote.
